installation.method: Downloaded keywright-install bundle; prebuilt image pulled by digest; no source checkout or local application build on the VM

knowledge.embedding_service: Local CPU-only Ollama; synthetic documents only; no paid embedding provider
knowledge.semantic_probe: The bicycle passage ranked first for human powered transportation, with no literal query-token overlap

roundtrip_measurement.description: Nine sequential MCP calls including client startup and protocol overhead; small warm sample, not a capacity benchmark

test_methods.interfaces: Admin setup, login, resource creation, knowledge publication/review and permission changes used HTTP UI forms. Agent operations used the installed MCP client against the running prebuilt broker.
test_methods.ssh_and_mcp: Dedicated synthetic upstream services; real SSH transport with a verified host key and a test-only client key; real upstream MCP transport.
test_methods.expiry: Published a synthetic operational document, indexed it, then moved only its database retention deadline into the past. Search/list/get excluded it while its old external-index row still existed. VM time was unchanged.
test_methods.model_change: Created an Ollama alias with the same model weights. Changing the configured model name invalidated old vectors; a rebuild restored coverage. The original model setting was restored and rebuilt.
test_methods.restore: Stopped the source broker before archiving its entire data volume. Restored into a new volume and a separate Compose project with a fresh pgvector database. Verified login, revisions, citations, audit history, permissions, SSH keys and a rebuilt semantic index.

limitations: Synthetic small-corpus validation does not establish large-corpus quality or throughput.
Hybrid retrieval returned five candidates for an absent topic. Ranked references and scores do not establish that a question is answerable.
VM execution covered AMD64. Native ARM64 prebuilt image and install-bundle checks passed in CI; a full ARM64 VM acceptance run was not performed.
HTTPS proxy, external notification delivery, OIDC and optional LLM gateway were outside this run.
No release tag, PyPI publication, public repository visibility or anonymous registry pull was performed.
